messages.subject: Project Harbor — draft report on title for your review
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Draft report on title attached. Headline: good and marketable title, NIY 6.25%, WAULT ~6.8 years. Four things flagged for the client — Penrose review, Harbourside break, the informal parking, and the bank charge discharge. I've recommended a £15k retention pending the rent review outcome.

Grateful for your mark-up before I send to Thornbury.

James
